title: Taiwan Detects 15 PLA Aircraft Sorties, 12 Crossing into Northern/Southwestern/Eastern ADIZ
detail: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense detected 15 PLA aircraft sorties, 8 PLAN vessels and 2 official ships operating around Taiwan in the 24 hours to 6 a.m. (UTC+8) September 16, 2026; 12 of the 15 sorties crossed the Taiwan Strait median line, entering the northern, southwestern and eastern ADIZ sectors — nearly double the prior day's count and the highest single-day tally since the Sept 7-8 surge. Taiwan's armed forces responded with CAP aircraft, navy ships and coastal missile systems. The uptick coincides with the opening day of Taiwan's own 3-day Jioupeng Base precision-strike live-fire drill in Pingtung County.

title: China May Secretly Arrange Taiwan Compatriot Permit for Labor Minister's Nanjing APEC Visit
detail: A Taiwan government source said Beijing might arrange a Taiwan compatriot permit for Minister of Labor Hung Sun-han without his knowledge ahead of his attendance at the APEC Human Resources Development Ministerial Meeting in Nanjing beginning September 23, 2026 — a longstanding Chinese practice for Taiwanese officials attending China-hosted APEC events, since Beijing does not recognize Taiwan travel documents. Hung is set to be the first minister in President Lai Ching-te's administration to visit China, entering via an APEC invitation letter through Taiwan's liaison channel rather than applying for a Mainland Travel Permit himself. The source noted more than 200 Taiwanese officials have previously attended APEC meetings in China without incident, but opposition figure Chuang Jui-hsiung said Beijing was 'taking advantage of this year's meeting being held in China.' Labor Minister Hung separately stressed 'reciprocal dignity' as a condition for the visit on September 15.
